scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @flashlearn/cli
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @flashlearn/extraction && npm run build --workspace @flashlearn/frontend && npm run build --workspace @flashlearn/learning && npm run build --workspace @flashlearn/storage
